doc.title: Ellen Rowe interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 2, 2024

title: University band video with alto flutes
summary: Monk noticed two alto flutes and a bass flute in a Michigan band video; Andrew Bishop was sitting in.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: By the way I watched a video of you conducting one of the university bands and I noticed two alto flutes and a bass flute. And I said wow — what a luxury.
Oh. I know what you saw. Yeah.

Exactly. I think yeah, because there’s not a lot of complete videos, well maybe there’s some livestreams out there but yeah, that’s very rare and I think if you look closely you saw that one of the members of the sax section was considerably older than the others and that was my colleague Andrew Bishop sitting in on alto flute. Yeah. Alto flute is not a double that many of our students — I think we own one in the department but yeah.
